events.label: Global financial crisis
events.description: RBI records the September 2008 global financial crisis as a sharp external shock that changed India’s monetary-policy challenge.

events.label: Tapering shock
events.description: RBI records US Federal Reserve tapering signals, capital outflows, and sharp pressure on the rupee in 2013.

events.label: Currency withdrawal
events.description: RBI recorded the 8 Nov 2016 withdrawal of legal-tender status for the ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes.

events.label: GST rollout
events.description: CBIC records the Goods and Services Tax rollout on 1 Jul 2017 as a major structural tax reform.

events.label: National lockdown
events.description: The Ministry of Home Affairs order of 24 Mar 2020 established a 21-day nationwide lockdown from 25 Mar.

events.label: War in Ukraine
events.description: RBI linked the conflict to higher global food, energy, and commodity prices and sustained inflation pressure in 2022.

events.label: Off-cycle tightening
events.description: The RBI raised the policy repo rate by 40 bps to 4.40% on 4 May 2022 amid elevated inflation pressures.

events.label: Easing cycle begins
events.description: The MPC cut the policy repo rate by 25 bps to 6.25% on 7 Feb 2025 and retained a neutral stance.
